svg.text: Cut 1,200 of 50 webbing; heat-seal both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sew a pair of D-rings into one end: 60 fold, box-and-cross stitch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Passes round the module and under the batten, in a bay between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frames, outboard of the module through the gap at the planks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Close: tail up through both rings, back over one, pull tight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tuck the tail; it must not slip when pulled by hand.
